svg.text: The field's canon, and the part an adoption metric can credit
The most-depended-on papers across 424 recovered bibliographies, scored on independent organisations naming them on a model
card — derivatives and same-company namespaces removed.
22 of these 42 papers have no independent adopter at all — hollow rings. Only 5 reach two: BERT, CLIP, RoBERTa, ViT, ResNet.
Every benchmark reading 1 is the SAME org — Google, because Gemma-3's card lists its eval suite. Ten separate 'adoptions' are one model card.
Counted in models rather than orgs those same ten read 7 apiece and look like a trend.
A model card names the model you started from — not the optimizer, the tokenizer or the benchmark.
Ids hand-verified; a canon paper whose id could not be confirmed is omitted rather than scored zero. Top-1,000-by-download listing only.
